v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Christus resúrgens ex mórtuis iam non móritur, mors illi ultra non dominábitur. Quod enim mórtuus est peccáto, mórtuus est semel: quod autem vivit, vivit Deo.
text.en: Knowing that Christ rising again from the dead, dieth now no more, death shall no more have dominion over him. For in that he died to sin, he died once; but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

r.en: Let heaven and earth rejoice, alleluia.

text.la: Ite, nuntiáte * frátribus meis, allelúia: ut eant in Galilǽam, allelúia: ibi me vidébunt, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Go, tell my brethren alleluia * that they go into Galilee, alleluia, there they shall see me, alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui in Fílii tui humilitáte iacéntem mundum erexísti: fidélibus tuis perpétuam concéde lætítiam; ut, quos perpétuæ mortis eripuísti cásibus, gáudiis fácias pérfrui sempitérnis.
text.en: O God, Whose Son hath humbled Himself, and Who hast through Him raised up the whole world, grant to thy faithful people everlasting joy; and as Thou hast delivered them from the bitter pains of eternal death, make them to be glad for ever in thy presence.

title.la: Ss. Alexandri I Papæ, Eventii et Theoduli Mm. ac Iuvenalis Ep. et Conf.

text.la: Fíliæ Ierúsalem, veníte et vidéte Mártyres cum corónis, quibus coronávit eos Dóminus in die solemnitátis et lætítiæ, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Daughters of Jerusalem, come and see the crowned martyrs, the Lord crowned them in his solemnity and delight, alleluia, alleluia.

v.en: Precious in the sight of the Lord, alleluia.

r.en: Is the death of his saints, alleluia.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui sanctórum tuórum Alexándri, Evéntii, Theodúli atque Iuvenális natalícia cólimus; a cunctis malis imminéntibus, eórum intercessiónibus, liberémur.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that we who do keep the birthday of thy holy servants Alexander, Eventius, Theodulus, and Juvenal, may by their prayers be delivered from all evils that presently hang over us.

office.title: Feria Quarta infra Hebd II post Octavam Paschæ
